policy: only official governing-body, league, tour or organiser endpoints are read
every recorded value is quoted from the page as read, not from memory
values that disagree with the register are corrected in the data and logged as irregularities
a row that was not re-read this session is labelled 'carried', never 'verified'

fetches.title: NHL official standings API — 2026-10-22
fetches.covers: 11 of 12 ice-hockey rows (team records, points percentage, goal differential, streak)
fetches.note: The endpoint returns the full 32-club table in eight pages; this session read the first two pages and recorded only the values shown here. Clubs outside those pages are not claimed as re-verified.

fetches.title: MLB StatsAPI — 2026 regular-season standings, both leagues
fetches.covers: 4 of 4 baseball rows (season record, home/road splits, runs scored and allowed)
fetches.note: Both clubs report 162 games played and lastUpdated 2026-10-21. The Brewers' run totals were not on the page fragment read this session, so only the Rays' runs are recorded as re-verified; the desk's runs-per-game inputs for Milwaukee are carried, not re-derived.
